slides.hook_sub: 4 profile mistakes and how to fix them
slides.visual: PhotoCover 4:5 with Karan's real rooftop photo, warm grade, headline top third in cream, red line = hook_red

slides.title: A new visitor gives your profile
slides.body: They check 3 things: your name, bio and pinned posts. If those aren't clear, they scroll on. Open your profile now and check.
slides.visual: White ground, red serif 02, mock profile header wireframe (no real account)

slides.title: Mistake 1: Just your name
slides.body: Add what you do to the name field. 'Karan | AI & Marketing' tells visitors right away what you teach.
slides.visual: Sand ground, before/after name field in two simple boxes

slides.title: Mistake 2: A bio full of vibes
slides.body: Your bio should say who it's for, what they get and the next step. Example: 'AI + marketing workflows for beginners. Free resource →'
slides.visual: White ground, bio text block with red arrow only

slides.title: Mistake 3: Random pinned posts
slides.body: Your top 3 pinned posts are your intro: 1 best value post, 1 personal story, 1 proof. Proof must be real.
slides.visual: Sand ground, 3 square placeholders labelled Value / Story / Proof

slides.title: Mistake 4: 10 links in bio
slides.body: A confused visitor clicks nothing. Pick one main action: free resource, WhatsApp or a call. Add the rest later.
slides.visual: White ground, 10 tiny link pills crossed to 1 clear pill

slides.cta_body: Comment "AI" and I'll DM you a 4-point profile checklist.
slides.visual: Espresso ground, cream Comment "AI" pill with red up-arrow, handle footer

posts.caption:
Instagram profile tips that turn visitors into followers.

Most people put all their effort into reels. But when someone lands on the profile, nothing is clear: just a name, a bio full of vibes and random pinned posts.

This carousel covers 4 mistakes and the fix for each. Read slide 2, open your own profile and check it. It takes 2 minutes.

hook_options: Got a lead but no reply?
You ran the ad and got the lead. Now what?
3 messages that stop leads going cold

slides.hook: Got a lead but no reply?
slides.hook_sub: Copy-paste WhatsApp follow-ups for small businesses
slides.visual: Type cover on white, serif hook, red punch line, footer Swipe →

slides.title: One missed follow-up,
slides.body: After filling a form, people check 2 or 3 other options too. Whoever replies first and clearly usually wins the conversation.
slides.visual: Sand ground, red serif 02, simple chat bubble outline

slides.title: Message 1: Right away
slides.body: "Hi [Name], thanks for your interest in [Business]! What do you need [product] for?" One question makes replying easy.
slides.visual: White ground, chat bubble with template, brackets in clay

slides.title: Message 2: Next day
slides.body: "[Name], quick answer to your question: [1 useful tip or price range]. Want a 5-minute call?"
slides.visual: Sand ground, chat bubble with template

slides.title: Message 3: Day three
slides.body: "Just checking in: are you still looking at [product]? If not, no problem, let me know and I'll update my list."
slides.visual: White ground, chat bubble with template

slides.title: 3 rules that
slides.body: Use their name. Ask one question per message. Stop after three. Only message people who gave you their number.
slides.visual: Sand ground, three short lines, red serif numbers

slides.cta_body: Comment "AI" and I'll DM you an editable follow-up sheet.
slides.visual: Espresso ground, cream Comment "AI" pill with red up-arrow

posts.caption:
WhatsApp follow-up messages for leads: copy-paste templates.

You spent on ads, the lead came in... and then nobody replied, or one 'Hi' was sent and forgotten. This is where many small businesses lose leads.

This carousel has 3 messages: right away, next day and day three. Fill in the brackets and send. One rule: only message people who gave you their number.

Comment "AI" and I'll DM you the editable follow-up sheet.

posts.linkedin_post:
Leads come in. Follow-ups don't happen. For small businesses, that's the cheapest leak to fix.

My simple 3-message system:
1. Right away: thanks + one question
2. Next day: one useful answer + an offer to call
3. Day three: a soft close

Rules: use their name, one question per message, stop after three, and only message opted-in leads.

Comment "AI" if you want the templates.
